name: Aditi
title: Happy Birthday
wish: Another year of you being exactly you. May this one be loud with laughter, full of good food, and kind to your dreams. Thank you for every chat, every plan and every random Tuesday that turned into a story.
surprise: Surprise! Here is a big virtual hug, a slice of cake and a promise of many more good days together.

scratch.title: A treat is on me!
scratch.text: Good for one dinner or dessert of your choice. Valid forever.

reasons.m: You care about people without making a show of it. That kind of kindness is rare.
You can turn the most ordinary day into a story worth retelling.
Your energy lifts a room. People feel lighter the moment you walk in.
You show up, you listen, and you remember the little things.
You keep going when things get hard, and you make it look easy.
You think things through and still find time to laugh at them.
You find the bright side faster than anyone I know.
It is contagious, in the best possible way.
You give your time, your help and your attention, and never keep score.
You try new things with real guts, and that inspires the people around you.
You tell the truth kindly, which is harder than it sounds.
You are the person people want to call first when something happens.
Your dreams are big, and you actually work towards them.
Every plan gets better when you are part of it.
You treat everyone like they matter, whoever they are.
When you say you will be there, you are there.
You hear what people mean, not just what they say.
There is no one else like you, and it shows in the best ways.
I am lucky to know you, and I mean that.
Not for what you do, but for who you are. Happy Birthday!
